name: preferences
title: Preferences
description: A fan's settings for a game, as one group on their Profile: a heading, then full-width rows joined into one list, a toggle at the end of a row that switches and a chevron at the end of a row that opens something, and a small link under the group for things like Report copyright infringement. A `slot` row is one the Gamestage client fills, such as data-gs-slot="privacy-settings", so its Privacy settings control is drawn as a row of the group. Owns no words and performs nothing: a toggle reports its new value and a row reports the press.
docs: Pass `title` and `items`: `{ kind: 'toggle', label, checked, onChange }`, `{ kind: 'link', label, onOpen }`, or `{ kind: 'slot', slot: 'privacy-settings' }` for the row the client fills. Pass `footer` for a small link below the group. Every word comes from the host, which reads it from Studio.
